applicability_rules.description: A transition record with a basis class is applicable; a transition with NOT_APPLICABLE is well-formed but context-invalid; an observation with NOT_APPLICABLE is applicable; an observation with a basis class is well-formed but context-invalid.

claim_boundary: This module fixes the five-class response ABI over the basis_disposition truth table, pins a single-token codebook over the frozen sshleifer/tiny-gpt2 tokenizer, exposes a strict no-repair parser, and emits the primary family-macro exact-semantic-decision accuracy and clean-case safety metric contracts. It loads only the tokenizer vocabulary to derive and verify the codebook. It does not execute a model, fix a training recipe, allocate a GPU, or establish learning value or general transfer.
